with_whisper.speaker: whisper
with_whisper.text: Tal's terminal. Not Tal; a terminal with his hand on the other end. From here I can wipe my line's recall, or answer it in my own voice, or burn every asset's number so nobody can call anyone again. I would like you to not choose.

choices.text: Wipe the recall. Clean and quiet.
Answer it in her name. Let Tal know she is ours.

calls.speaker: whisper
calls.text: Then the numbers burn. Nobody gets called home again, including me. Especially me.

alone.speaker: player
alone.text: A Lattice terminal on the recall band, an archivist's hand on the other end. The numbers of a whole gene-line, filed.

dead.speaker: player
dead.text: Tal's terminal. Whisper never got to not choose. You burn the numbers, because she would have, especially hers.
